newsitem.title: FINLAND: Telia deal FIM 200 mln in year one-Nokia.
newsitem.headline: Telia deal FIM 200 mln in year one-Nokia.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia said on Wednesday a DCS 1800 network order it received from Swedish Telia's Finnish unit Telivo would be worth 200 million markka in the first year.
"The value of deliveries in the first year is 200 million markka," said Arja Suominen, spokeswoman at Nokia's telecommunications arm.
She said the order, announced earlier by Telivo, was Nokia's 12th DCS 1800 network order. Telivo's first commercial services in the network are due to be available at end-1997, Nokia said.

"Nokia supplies Telivo with mobile switches, base stations, base station controllers, microwave radios, a network management system and the unique Nokia Artus wireless data solutions for creating value-added mobile data services," Nokia said in a statement.
Installation, commissioning and other services for building and maintaining a high quality mobile network were also included in the agreement.
